description: Pull two Spaces together/apart — Touch, a Distance gap, or Centroid; Point or Edge-flush contact; move A / B / both. Inputs: Space A (main) + Space B; outputs the two new Spaces.
instructions:
Pulls two Spaces together (or apart). Main input = Space A; the `gin-b` input = Space B. Returns the two transformed Spaces on out-0 (A) and out-1 (B).

MODE (`mode`)
• touch — bring them into contact.
• distance — leave a `distance` (m) gap.
• centroid — slam centroids together (a pure move; contact / edge-slide don't apply).

`contact` = point (closest points) or edge-flush; `anchor` chooses which of A / B / both moves; `edgeSlide` lets an edge-flush contact slide along the shared edge.

TIP: use edge-flush + move B to snap a room against a shared wall.
